question: Who is addressed as the primordial god, ancient person, supreme treasure, knower and knowable, and all-pervading abode of the infinite universe?
premises: The addressee is the primordial god.
The addressee is the ancient person.
The addressee is the supreme treasure of this universe.
The addressee is both knower and knowable.
The addressee is the supreme abode.
By the addressee the universe of infinite form is pervaded.
inference: The verse identifies the addressee as the all-pervading supreme source, knower, and abode of the universe.
plain_english: You are the primordial god, the ancient person; you are the supreme treasure of this universe; you are the knower and the knowable, the supreme abode; by you the universe of infinite form is pervaded.
